format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-tag-group id="g-rm" aria-label="Города"><sf-tag kind="default" closable text="Москва"></sf-tag><sf-tag kind="default" closable text="Казань"></sf-tag><sf-tag kind="default" closable text="Тверь"></sf-tag></sf-tag-group>

<sf-tag-group id="g-one" aria-label="Показать" selection="one"><sf-tag key="all" text="Все"></sf-tag><sf-tag key="new" text="Новые" active></sf-tag><sf-tag key="mine" text="Мои"></sf-tag></sf-tag-group>

probes.title: a list of listitems, the tags 4 apart

steps.check: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('#g-rm'); const tags = [...g.querySelectorAll(':scope > sf-tag')]; const a = tags[0].querySelector('.sf-tag').getBoundingClientRect(); const b = tags[1].querySelector('.sf-tag').getBoundingClientRect(); return g.getAttribute('role') === 'list' && tags.every((t) => t.getAttribute('role') === 'listitem') && Math.round(b.left - a.right) === 4 && getComputedStyle(g).display === 'flex'; })()

probes.title: the row is one Tab stop; ArrowRight moves to the next tag and End to the last

steps.check: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('#g-rm'); const stops = [...g.querySelectorAll('button')].filter((b) => b.tabIndex >= 0); return stops.length === 1; })()

probes.title: Delete removes the tag stood on (the page removes it on sf-tag-close) and the focus goes to its neighbour; the step is said

steps.check: (() => { const tags = [...document.querySelectorAll('#g-rm > sf-tag')]; return tags.length === 2 && tags[0].getAttribute('text') === 'Казань' && document.activeElement === tags[0].querySelector('button') && /Казань, 1 из 2/u.test(document.querySelector('[data-sf-tag-said]')?.textContent || ''); })()

probes.title: selection one: choosing a tag clears the others and sends sf-tag-group-select; selected is its key

steps.check: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('#g-one'); const d = window.__sel[0]; return g.selected === 'mine' && JSON.stringify(g.selectedIds) === '["mine"]' && !g.querySelector('sf-tag[key="new"]').hasAttribute('active') && d && d.id === 'mine' && d.selected === true && JSON.stringify(d.ids) === '["mine"]'; })()

probes.title: layout row: the tags that do not fit leave the row and «+N» stands after the last one shown; it opens a popover with the hidden tags and their crosses; a cross there removes the page's tag

steps.check: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('#g-more'); const over = g.querySelectorAll(':scope > sf-tag[data-sf-tag-over]').length; const more = g.querySelector(':scope > [data-sf-tag-group-more]'); const n = more?.querySelector('sf-tag[slot="trigger"]')?.getAttribute('text'); const gb = g.getBoundingClientRect(); return over > 0 && n === `+${over}` && more.getAttribute('role') === 'listitem' && more.getBoundingClientRect().right <= gb.right + 0.5 && gb.height < 48; })()

(() => { const g = document.querySelector('#g-more'); const pop = g.querySelector('sf-popover'); const copies = pop.querySelectorAll('[slot="content"] sf-tag'); return pop.open && copies.length === g.querySelectorAll(':scope > sf-tag[data-sf-tag-over]').length && copies[0].querySelector('sf-button-close, .sf-icon-button'); })()

steps.script: (window.__before = document.querySelectorAll('#g-more > sf-tag').length, document.querySelector('#g-more sf-popover [slot="content"] sf-tag sf-button-close button').click(), true)

probes.title: layout wrap: every tag in view on more lines, no «+N»
